set.body:
Alder's pinned build (e555bad, also Alder main c56a6b1) loads Gale 099832f, 44 commits behind the Gale 6f7a1f9 that ScalaFIM and mvpa4s pin. Without a Gale path override, ScalaFIM mvpa-dataset and mvpa4s-predictive classpaths carry two gale.* source builds; a signature change (e.g. defaulted parameter) can compile and then fail with NoSuchMethodError or a Scala.js link error. Alder overrides take only checkout paths, so consumers cannot redirect it to a git URI. Also: ScalaFIM's alderRevision e555bad is only on Alder branch umvpa/native-fixed-roles-20260930, not Alder main.

Acceptance: Alder pins Gale 6f7a1f9 (or ScalaFIM/mvpa4s pins align with Alder's) on a published Alder main revision; ScalaFIM and mvpa4s bump alderRevision; mvpa4s tools/prepare-pinned-dependencies.sh rejects an Alder/mvpa4s Gale mismatch as it does for Multivar; drop the README skew note.
set.title: Align Alder's Gale pin with the ScalaFIM/mvpa4s Gale revision
